items.name: phase4_extractibility_and_wrapper_selection
items.gate: raw/random/trained extraction plus weekly wrapper validation and final manifest
items.evidence: The scoped TRAIN extractibility successor closed; the 2024 weekly wrapper completed 6240/6240 tasks across RAW, RANDOM_ENCODER and TRAINED_ENCODER with zero technical task failures. Warehouse readback reconciled, 20 target-specific RAW winners were chosen and the procedure was frozen without opening TEST. Winner unions are 20 EURUSD and 9 ETH features, but all 20 mean weekly skill scores are negative against the paired naive, so no trading-ready feature set is claimed. The older 6495-task parent closure is superseded for this scoped wave and must not be counted as the current queue.

items.name: architecture_controls
items.gate: matched ARCH result
items.evidence: The selected-input EURUSD Y_s_1h business adaptation completed 208/208 cells over 52 weekly 2024 validation weeks, one seed, with same-row naive and paired populations; closure d25425393ae537288b09cdeb21382cc7ea253292cc161bff0866be039ccc0b0b. ARCH-B mean MAE 0.000500321 versus ARCH-A 0.000511972 and naive 0.000492891, so no arm passes the trading eligibility gate. The first ARCH-C implementation omitted the origin; its receipts are archived and only that arm was rerun with a new architecture identity. Warehouse readback: 208 reports and 1664 metrics, lineage UNVERIFIED for retained local parquets. A separate Y_l_24h successor is RUNNING on two measured GPUs, with its own target support and no aggregate yet. General E0 mechanism H2/H3, literature-model and other target/horizon controls remain open; no TEST was read.

items.name: per_feature_dense_architecture_controls
items.gate: faithful historical per-feature Dense ANN replay or typed NOT_REPRODUCIBLE, plus matched causal-window Dense versus Conv1D branch result on final features and weekly rows
items.evidence: A whole-model control completed 104/104 cells over EURUSD Y_s_1h, the selected 20-feature union, 52 weekly 2024 validation weeks, 6196 same-row observations and seed 0. With a fit-only robust target coordinate, temporal Conv MAE was 0.000493193 versus non-temporal Dense 0.000502364 and paired naive 0.000492598; neither arm is trading-eligible. Closure 46c84b3f256b993ba0b206ac0f90efe3d006c3589f3f422a7bae1ee6a4bacd67; TEST unread. This orders the two whole-model controls but does not complete the branch-only swap or the historical ANN authentication required by the gate.
